reviews.title: Great App
reviews.text: Once you learn the app, it’s very easy to use. I only use custom entries and while it took a while to build them, it’s well worth it for accuracy in your tracking. Switched from another app and will never go back. Customer support is very responsive and helpful.

reviews.title: LAME
reviews.text:
I DO NOT RECOMMEND THIS APP. 

My experience with this app has been nothing but bad. The bar code scanner has yet to find ANYTHING I have scanned, that is when it isn’t saying “it can’t find the barcode”, resulting in me manually entering everything. 

The AI scanner? Equally garbage experience. 

Scanning the nutrition label is fantastic in that it will see everything on it. You just have to input the name of the food in it, right? WRONG! Because once you save it, you have to go back in to it and manually enter all the macros because it reduces everything to a tenth of the actual macro. 

I made the mistake of subscribing because I thought being able to access those features would make the app better to use. I was wrong. (I won’t even go into how the app locked up when I subscribed or the first time when I tried to take advantage of the “one time” discount. 

TRASH APP.

reviews.title: Great tool with some limitations
reviews.text: Great tool but the library of food to choose from is limited and the bar code scanning is also not the best. Could use improvement.

reviews.title: Ehh
reviews.text: It works. Entering food quickly can be annoying. There food lists sucks.

reviews.title: Life changing
reviews.text: Life changing

reviews.title: No barcode scanner and won’t take pic of nutrition labels.
reviews.text:
This is not worth the $35 per year they want for “pro”. Food database is pathetic and it’s very difficult to enter and track food manually so can’t really assess the benefits of the program.  Also the pro subscription price for a year is listed as $20/year in the App Store, not the &35 they ask for in the app. Of course the App Store listing has several yearly subscription prices which I find extremely disingenuous. I am deleting this and sorry I wasted my time trying it out. 

Addendum: when I went to delete it there was an option to scan for food. I don’t understand why they wouldn’t give access to it directly in the app,  it instead you have to shut is down and hold it long enough to see other options. Pretty convoluted and adds an extra unnecessary step, butt to I will give it another chance. Not changing my review or rating yet aa I haven’t had time to fully evaluate it but if I see that it’s worth the trouble I’ll come back and change my review.

reviews.title: Great app
reviews.text: I’ve tried all the macro apps and this one’s my favorite. Able to find all the foods I’ve searched for. Barcode scanners great.

reviews.title: Superior.
reviews.text: This app is amazing for tracking macros. I love using it for tracking my own cooking as well as most restaurant meals. I have used this app for a bikini comp, building muscle, gaining weight for pregnancies, and now to trim back down some during my motherhood years. Through all stages, this app has been far superior to the competition. Bought the app almost 10 years ago and have reaped all the rewards and benefited from all the updates.

reviews.title: Great update!
reviews.text: This last update with the improvements to food search are sooo good! Great update MM+ team

reviews.title: Horrible
reviews.text: Food choices are limited even with global choices turned on. Even common basic foods fail to come up. Worst food tracking app ever

reviews.title: Pretty good, update makes it slow
reviews.text:
I’ve been using MM+ for two years. It was hard to get the hang of it until I subscribed to a nutrition coach with another company who gave me tips that made it a lot easier. 

The latest free updates had made it not smooth. It’s very laggy as each individual letter causes the search to go nuts. Very annoying. I’m looking for a new app.

reviews.title: Great Tool
reviews.text: I have been using this tool for almost 4 years. It’s reliable and resourceful. Takes a little getting used to when starting, but they are continuously updating and adding features. Customer service is amazing. I got a new phone and thought I lost all of my data—sent an email and had it all restored within 24 hours.

reviews.title: Solid app with excellent support
reviews.text: Great app for tracking, especially once you’ve got your recipes and regular items added. Excellent support team with quick, personal response when a new phone appeared to lose my data. Also love that many basic ingredients are already entered (fruits and vegetables)

reviews.title: Game changer
reviews.text: MM+ has been a game changer for my health journey. Logging foods is simple with MM+. I started using the app to bring awareness to what and how much I was eating. Once I had that information, I then began making changes in order to achieve my health goals (lose fat, build & maintain muscle - yes strength training is also a component). My favorite features of MM+ are being able to copy meals or even entire days (repeat eat, here!) and access to”recent” foods quickly.

reviews.title: Great app
reviews.text: Had an issue where I lost everything/all of my data. Reached out to Support for help. Helped me recover everything within minutes. Thank you for the help and quick turn around time!

reviews.title: Long Term User
reviews.text: Hello everyone. I’ve used this app for years now, and I reccomend it to everyone. It’s easy to innput meals. Most entries have tons of accurate weights/calories to choose from. The app is updated often. Only reason I didn’t give 5 stars is because there is a “premium “ version. The app costs money, so we shouldn’t have to pay again to access all the features.

reviews.title: It’s just OK
reviews.text:
I want to like this, but ugh. It doesn’t sync even when you force a sync. So if I log on another device or the website, nothing makes it onto the app. There should also be a better way to search for foods I eat regularly. Daily I log a specific creamer…and daily I have to go through my recent foods to find it. Why can’t I just search and find it? Which brings me to the  search function, as a whole it rarely finds what I’m looking for. Even when I search for things I manually added. Overall, there are too many options to bother using one that lacks so much functionality and intuitive behavior.

Update: I wrote this review on 4/15/2025. They responded today, 6/11/2026 and suggested I contact customer support for help with my issues. No thanks, think I’ll just move on like I did 14 months ago. Lowering rating from 3 to 1 stars.

reviews.title: Scam
reviews.text: I cancelled my subscription (through Apple) in 2024 and I am still being charged monthly. Subscription no longer shows up on Apple, and unable to cancel my subscription through the My Macros website. They are a scam.

reviews.title: Helping me reach my goals
reviews.text: I love Mymacros+. Now that I have added the foods I eat regularly into the custom journal, it is very easy to track my food. With the support of this app, I've really learned how to eat and feed my body what it needs to be healthy. I love all the features. I've completed my first bulk and cut with the help of mymacros+. Love it!

reviews.title: Reliable and Easy to Use
reviews.text: Been using My Macros+ | Macro Tracker for years and it’s still my go-to macro tracking app. Simple, reliable, and makes staying on track so much easier.

reviews.title: Glitchy
reviews.text: It used to be great but it’s turned so glitchy since the update. Typing is lagged when searching for food. I type in a specific food item and it shows me everything but that. It’s getting annoying.

reviews.title: Difficult to apply goals
reviews.text: Still trying to figure out how to fully use this tracker without having to pay more money for the AI assistant.

reviews.title: Garbage
reviews.text: Just downloaded today, not user friendly at all, barcode scanner is the worst. Very frustrating!

reviews.title: Used to be the best
reviews.text: I’ve been using this app on and off for at least 6 years. The food database search used to be clean now it is nothing but fast food or processed foods. I waste way too much time searching for clean food to log. Time to move on.

reviews.title: User friendly!
reviews.text: I like this app. Especially once I got all my recipes and foods I eat in there, super quick!

reviews.title: Just ok.
reviews.text: Not very user friendly especially for the beginners. Doesn’t calculate calcium and potassium intake. Search needs much improvement. Conversion from oz to grams and back would be nice.

reviews.title: Great support
reviews.text: This app makes it so easy to stay on track.  It is also a huge help when I am looking for a snack.  I can see where I am for the day and I am confident I can have something to eat.  It keeps track of the important numbers for me.  I am very happy with the app.

reviews.title: Review
reviews.text: I hate the new update. Why did you delete the type of food option?

reviews.title: This is the App!
reviews.text: I’ve tried a lot of food tracking apps and this is by far my favorite.

reviews.title: Update - bad
reviews.text: You guys need to update the app again. My app crashed immediately when I try to search up what food to input. Every single time.

reviews.title: Search function is poor
reviews.text: App works great and has many neat features. My only complain is the search function. I put in the word “roll” and the first 30 options were nothing remotely related to a bread roll.

reviews.title: Great app for tracking
reviews.text: Love using this app to track my macros. This app was recommended to me by my personal trainer and it has helped me dial my macros down to help reach my goals!

reviews.title: Many quirks
reviews.text: Took me FOREVER to become accustomed to this app after MFP. I’m still super frustrated by it. It’s annoying when you’re searching something by typing in the item and all these irrelevant things come up. So you go to your favorites and you have to type in the item again. If you go to “recents” first and it’s not there, you’re typing it in for a 3rd time. Many small time wasters like this when you just want to eat. The only way this really works if you don’t pay attention to any other entries but your own and you eat the same things all the time and make sure you include the grams in the description because if you threw away the packaging, you won’t know the serving size. But you can waste time going to the website to find it and now your food is cold or your partner is done eating. Scanning the barcode apparently doesn’t work because the values are wrong and it’s somewhat true. Just making it more difficult. I don’t pretend to be smarter than these app developers. It’s probably my age or my short attention span but after 3 months, it’s only moderately easier. Thank goodness for AI in many of my cases. Minor annoyance, I wish it would show you your week’s averages so if you had 1 cheat day and 6 really good days, you could see where you averaged.

reviews.title: Did you ruin this app?
reviews.text: I used to use this app regularly and had all of my meals named with my macro goals for that meal and a bunch of favorite foods. Now I come back to the app after a few months not counting and discover you’ve wiped ALL of that away and ruined all the effort I put into this app previously. Please tell me I’m just missing something!

reviews.title: I’m koi
reviews.text: On no k

reviews.title: Incorrect calorie info
reviews.text: Idk why on my phone, when I scan the barcode or when I scan the label, it doesn’t record the correct info for the items macro’s. Greek yogurt for an example, is 100 cal and 17g of protein. But when I scan it and I it shows up as 5g of protein per serving. Not really happy with the purchase I made in this app.

reviews.title: Upgrade to enter oz
reviews.text: Seriously? You fail to scan the barcode correctly then want to charge me to manually enter the oz-based serving in the label.

reviews.title: Great app and even better customer support
reviews.text: I had been using this app for years and I love it, so easy to use. Well I logged out one days and I’ve been using it so long I forgot my username and password. I reached out to customer support and they help me get back in. There are may tracking apps out there but this is by far the best!

reviews.title: Can’t add notes
reviews.text: They removed the ability to add notes to your day and placed it behind the paywall of subscription. Something as basic and important any tracking app should have.

reviews.title: Bring back the old barcode scanner
reviews.text: I’ve used this app for 4 years now and have loved it. Recently the barcode scanner changed, and it’s horrible. It used to automatically scan and now you need to take a picture and most of the time it can’t detect the barcode. I don’t understand how it got drastically worse but please fix it. It used to be quick and convenient. Now it’s a hassle. I sat here trying to scan this barcode for 5 minutes before manually entering the info.

reviews.title: elly_K
reviews.text: Overall I enjoy MM+. Customer service is very prompt with responding to issues. As for the app, I find that most the foods I scan do not match the nutritional label. So it’s easier for me to just add each one in line by line on the nutrition label. Maybe that’s an issue with the nutritional bar codes? I also feel there extra clicking that needs to be done between recipes and logging individual ingredients, but once you get used to it, it’s fine. It would be nice to have the last food logged pop up as the last entered amount (grams, ounces, etc) instead of “1” each time. These may possibly be something with my settings being incorrect but overall it allows for the intended purpose.

reviews.title: Broken functionality hasn’t been fixed in years
reviews.text:
It’s also almost impossible to find standard items in the search such as onion, potato, or other fruits and veggies.
You have to make a custom food item for each of those things, which makes no sense at all to me. Basic food items should be easily searchable. 

Additionally, most food items are not easily found when searching. You have to scroll through a sea of garbage results that have nothing in common with what you searched for, and you usually still won’t find what you searched for. 

Button to log an item is top right, versus being bottom center, not huge, but annoying that this app looks like it’s from 2000 when every other app has moved to new UI. 

Also, there’s buttons that live half off of my phone screen and almost aren’t reachable. Apparently they don’t do any testing when building a mobile app to make sure it fits. 

Not sure if I’m gonna stick with this app. Torn because I think what it offers is better than most tracking apps, but it seems to be broken in some major ways.

reviews.title: Hate this newest scan update 2026.06
reviews.text: Which ever update initiated the new way to scan things whether it be the nutrition label or the barcode is absolute trash. You scan a nutrition label which has all the information but yet it still puts in wrong information. You scan a barcode and it tells you sorry we can’t find it or whatever it says. Thinking about uninstalling and finding a new app.

reviews.title: Love this app
reviews.text: I've literally used five or six other apps all paid versions and while they all have their benefit there was definitely things within each one of them that drove me crazy. When I found my macros I was frustrated I was just looking kind of for one app that would do and if I had a question I could get an answered. Ironically the biggest one out there took the reply to any of my questions cause I'm always refining and trying to get better at what I'm doing. But my macros is super prompt with customer service and when I mean I mean super prompt same-day responses tutorials they make sure I have what I need if I question something. And if that's good not good enough for you far cheaper than everybody else way more bang for the buck.

reviews.title: Outstanding
reviews.text: I started using this app again a little over a year ago just to be aware of all the nutrition I was putting into my body. The app is seamless to use but what earns a 5* is the customer service. Jason REALLY helped me out with a recent issue I had with my data after I updated my phone and lot everything. Speedy, accurate, and actually helpful, and my issue was resolved. Cheers!

reviews.title: My macros + and my strength book
reviews.text: My macros + and my strength book weren’t meshing with apple health being a middle man. Meaning stuff that I logged in my macros should go to apple health and then my strength book will read it and log it. Jason helped me until I got everything to work! Awesome customer service!

reviews.title: Thank Gawd for Jason
reviews.text:
I recently got a new phone and my data - allll my custom foods and recipes - did not transfer over. I sent a few emails and finally was blessed with the help of Jason, who quickly suggested the proper solution and voila! All my data is on my new phone. 

Excellent app and the customer service really comes through when you need them.

reviews.title: Highly recommend
reviews.text: I’ve had this app for several years now and think it’s an awesome app to track macros with. They’ve made great improvements over the years and I wouldn’t even consider switching because I am very happy with the app itself as well as their customer service. I switched devices once and had been an inactive user previous to the switch. They were able to restore all my data without issue. I highly recommend!

reviews.title: My favorite macro app
reviews.text: Been using this app for over 5 years. It’s easy and simple I have my favorites saved makes tracking easy, fast, and can easily scan barcodes

reviews.title: Amazing Customization
reviews.text:
I’ve been using this for years, it’s extremely easy to input custom foods however you most like to track them (I like to make serving sizes to 1 oz or gram depending on the food). 

Also, customer service has been great. When I bought a new phone and messed up re-uploading all of my years of custom food and data. They quickly responded and fixed it. I’m extremely thankful for their help.
